name: 8-bit ALU (116 logic gates)
description: 8-bit arithmetic-logic unit built ENTIRELY from logic gates: ripple-carry add/subtract, bitwise AND/OR, a 4:1 output mux, plus carry and zero flags. Opcode S1:S0 = 00 ADD / 01 SUB / 10 AND / 11 OR. Preset to ADD 0x35 + 0x1A = 0x4F (79). Run a transient (~300ns) and read result bits R0..R7 + C8 (carry) + ZERO. (Validated on ngspice across a full truth-table of vectors.)
